items.post_title_orig: 34 years ago today my first time seeing the guys
items.post_selftext:
This was the best festival I’ve ever attended. It was my first time seeing PJ and joined the 10 club early on.
 I’ve seen them a total of 6 times from 92-04. It’s doubtful I’ll ever get to see them again but thankful for each and every show that I went to.
    submitted by    /u/313_techno
